title: Image of Regular Unipotent under a Representation of $\mathrm{GL}_3(\mathbb{C})$
summary: We study the image of a regular unipotent element under any finite-dimensional irreducible polynomial representations of $\mathrm{GL}_3(\mathbb{C})$. This problem is equivalent to decomposing certain compositions of irreducible representations as $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{C})$-modules. We give an explicit decomposition of this finding, its Jordan decomposition.
